comment: joint_index refers to position in the rig's pose+tool chain (0..4 = the 5 pose DOFs: shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll; 5 = the gripper tool joint) -- exactly LeRobot's canonical SO-ARM servo IDs and names (lerobot/robots/so_follower/so_follower.py), so a trajectory recorded from the SO-ARM100/101 URDF import lines up directly with a real SO-ARM's motor bus.

servos.name: gripper
servos.range_deg_comment: SO-ARM100 jaw joint's own URDF limits (SO101 differs slightly: [-10.0, 100.0]; swap this if importing that URDF instead). Trajectories store raw degrees uniformly for every joint; range_0_100 servos need this range to convert degrees -> percent at playback time, or the gripper would be commanded with the wrong physical position.
